items.q: At one time, you know, one of the manager's of the Savoy, Charles Buchanan, he and Moe Gayle and all of them got together and they had a five-band tour.

ctx.x: When you did the circuits, how did you travel? By train or bus?
Bus. Bus. At one time, you know, one of the manager's of the Savoy, Charles Buchanan, he and Moe Gayle and all of them got together and they had a five-band tour.
